entries.content: A virus comprised of nanomachines. The M2 virus exists in all Machina and is used to both corrupt others and regenerate their bodies. Originally designed to enhance humans for the stresses of long distance space travel, M2 can improve itself resulting in its current state from spiralling out of control. M2 can only infect those of age, remaining dormant until at least adolescence. In the case of infecting a pregnant woman, M2 will keep her reproductive organs intact until giving birth. The M2 virus will turn those infected into futanari, regardless of gender.

The beginning stage of corruption, M2 courses through the infected and can be seen in the more prominent veins. Infected either pass this stage becoming Machina or can be cured if caught early enough. Infected individuals will establish a core within their bodies as their internal organs are converted into M2 production organs. Once a core is established, an infected cannot be cured.

Machina in this category retain most of their human appearance however, the installation of Machinium is evident, with the majority of their limbs modified. Additionally, an infected eyes will appear in their corrupted state. This is the last state the infected will enter before losing their mind to corruption, however it still possesses some control over the infected. This will occur once a larva bonds with their core.

The majority of Machina end up in this category, identified by their bodies taking on a full unnatural transformation. Ultimately, Machina in this category lose their mind to the M2 virus, becoming drones for the corruption. Usually, it takes 1 full month to develop to this stage, however it can be sped up with additional M2 or larvae, occasionally some Queens can slow down this process too. Machina of this category will attempt to grow stronger by fusing with more larvae, upgrading their systems.

A rare category of Machina and typically linked to Queen Classes, Category 4 Machina are considered highly dangerous, so much so that several squads of Agents are sent to deal with a single one. To ascend to this category, a Machina must either possess a body with high aptitude for M2, consume an excessive amount of M2 or utilise several Larvae to upgrade their bodies. Notably possessing a third eye on their foreheads, typically called the Queen's eye and is a symbol of a fully developed Machina brain and horns.

Usually associated with Category 4 Machina, Queen Class typically have access to a Throne and are originators of a Gene-code. Machina obtain this class when ascending to Category 4, whilst retaining their original abilities. These Machina appear to possess more of a personality than other classes. Queen class Machina are the apex of their Cluster and connected to the main Cluster, acting as a central hub.

Used as a common denominator to refer to the 7 strongest Machina. In terms of power, ALPHA Machina are beyond anything we can record and are considered as ultra dangerous threats to life itself. It is currently unknown how these Machina reached this state. Reports are known about such beings, Uroboros, Behemoth, Jagannath, Jangsan Beom, Shiva, Thoth and Belphegor. These Machina are currently competing to become the OMEGA, the true ruler of Machina.

Small, dog sized drones that can infect humans. Larvae will inject M2 nanomachines into human targets, utilising their metal forms and power cores to speed up the process. When using Larvae, the process of infecting a human can take only a few hours to complete instead of a month. Additionally, Machina can utilise Larvae to enhance their own bodies, strengthening whatever part it is attached to.

REPAIR personnel combatants who utilise RM to enhance their bodies to engage Machina. Typically utilising cybernetics to enhance their bodies even further despite the dangers associated with doing so.

Machina of this class are designed for high speed, always with flight and enhanced durability. Subtypes of this class can include Bomber type, Fighter type, Gargoyle type, Harpy type, Raptor type, Shadow type and Yaksha type. Fighter types are the most common for an Assaulter class Machina.

Whilst all Machina can infect others, Injector classes are designed for this purpose, being one of non-combat classes, additionally being the most common of Machina. Subtypes of this class can include Ambusher type, Bee, Bovine, Cannon, Claw type, Fog, Foundry type, Healer, Sniper and Standard type. Standard types are the most common for an Injector class Machina.
This category is used for those who have been captured by Machina and are being prepared for corruption.

A Hybrid class is when a Machina obtains enough gene-code to acquire abilities of another class. A Chimera class is used for when a Machina possesses 3 or more classes. It is believed that becoming a Chimera class Machina is required for an ascension into Queen class.

The bases of corruption, these corrupt areas are created by Queen Class Machina. Considered death traps to regular people and even cyborgs, this hives possess living mechanical walls and act as nurseries for the M2 virus. The inside of a Hive is typically full of high concentrations of M2 in the air, threatening to infect anything that enters.

Machina of this class typically possess high firepower and are designated based on what type of weapon they wield. Additionally, Attacker class Machina integrate human weaponry and technology into their bodies regularly, adapting to their resistance. Subtypes of this class can include Beast type, Brawler type, Cannon type, Destroyer type, Gladiator type, Oni type, Protector type, Shield type and Siren type. Beast types are the most common for an Attacker class Machina.

Cyborgs of this class are known to take less of a combat role and provide their allies with reinforcement such as intelligence, reconnaissance and research. Subtypes of this class can include Butler type, Ghost type, Growler type, Infiltrator type, Scientist type, Succubus type and Wyrm type. Supporter Class do not possess an overall common type.

Machina of the Breeder class are one of three non-combative classes, specialised to create Larvae, each of their breasts possess wombs for growing Larvae. Typically producing less M2 than other classes, Breeder class Machina instead receive it from fluids of other Machina like semen in exchange for providing Larvae to other Machina. Subtypes of this class can include Advanced type, Catalic type, Fabricator type, Nurse type and Standard type. Standard types are the most common for an Breeder class Machina.

The biggest human religion in terms of followers and political power. Combining several old world religions together, Catalism teaches about the End, a form of enlightenment and a spirit that followers wish to become a part of. However, this church is nothing but a front for the Machina to corrupt more humans into their ranks.

An enhanced mode that Machina can use, cladding the entirety of their bodies in black metal. Only Category 3 and Category 4 Machina can utilise this mode however, only Category 4 Machina can reliably utilise such a form, with Category 3 Machina needing to be Blessed and only capable of lasting mere minutes in comparison to the several hours a Category 4 can achieve.
When a Queen class Machina ejaculates into a Category 3 Machina, they become blessed by the Queen's seed, receiving powerful traits based on the Queen and access to their Gyno Mode

The human faction in combating Machina, comprised of researchers carrying out anti-Machina research and agents who perform planned strikes against Machina. Typically female due to the requirements of RM nanomachine to resist infection, the remaining human population is conscripted through mandatory testing for RM compatibility.

The result of a human being infected with M2 nanomachines, creating a symbiotic link between the host and M2. Sorted into categories based on their development and classes based on their capabilities, these beings are considered a threat to all humanity. All Machina are futanari in order to have sex regardless of gender.

A reverse-engineered variant of M2 nanomachines, REPAIR Multipurpose nanomachines are used by REPAIR personnel to enhance their abilities. Requiring suitable females with compatibility with RM, this variant can break out of its "safe mode" and return back into M2 when mismanaged. RM, much like M2, causes its host to have heightened libido and feelings of power which could result in RM being spread to incompatible humans causing an M2 outbreak.

REPAIR personnel of Rank C are mostly non-combatants, inoculated with RM to resist M2 and possessing cybernetics up to 25% of their body. Comprised of mostly junior researchers and Agents in training, Rank C personnel are only deployed for small-scale missions.

REPAIR personnel of Rank B are usually Agents capable of fighting Machina one-on-one, usually possessing extensive cybernetics to further enhance their bodies. Senior researchers additionally reside within this rank. Around 50% of Rank B personnel are female, whilst the other 50% are futanari, the effects of RM starting to influence their bodies.

REPAIR personnel of Rank A possess a high tolerance to RM, generally having over 50% of their bodies full of cybernetics and with 80% being futanari. Rank A personnel additionally require regular maintenance due to their bodies lack of moderation of RM. Rank A personnel produce an enormous amount of RM, even their breath containing it, resulting in Rank A personnel wearing gas masks and containment suits when not in combat environments, this high RM production also permanently warps personnel's minds, causing decreased inhibitions and increased libido.
A tool used by certain Rank A Agents, Marionettes are effectively mindless clones of the Agent, used as extensions of an Agent's body.

Fractional Enhancement Method: Biological Overhaul Initiative, aka FEMBOI, is a project to alter males to be compatible with RM nanomachines. Only a small handful of males have been successful through this program to be properly inoculated with RM.

A portion of a Machina's Gene-code that governs their M2's behaviour, a Instinct-Code is effectively a database of biotechnology and knowledge. When Machina's fluids are shared, their Instinct-Code updates with each others information, becoming stronger and resulting in Machina willingly wanting to share their bodily fluids with one another.

A portion of a Machina's Gene-code controlled by a Queen class and their Cluster members, enforcing a Queen's authority over her Cluster. Machina ascending to Category 4, overwrite their Cluster-Code with one of their own. A Cluster-Code will additionally contain important features of a Queen, resulting her Cluster members possessing similar appearances and abilities to their Queen.
A portion of a Machina's Gene-code that holds unique genetic information, constantly updating to match their physical qualities.

A Cluster is a network of Machina belonging to a Queen class, with the Queen acting as the central controller of the network. Clusters are separated into Local, Imperial and Main clusters. Local Clusters are Clusters ran by a single Queen class Machina. Imperial Clusters are several Clusters that have been merged under the control of a single Queen, usually through domination. The Main Cluster is the true home of Machina, a hub connecting all Machina

The theoretical end goal of Machina evolution, with the closest to it being the current 7 ALPHAs. If an OMEGA were to come about, they would have total control over the main Cluster and thus all Machina.

A title shared by the first two Queen class Machina, they are considered a neutral party amongst Queens and even ALPHAs. An Auditor possesses the ability to order Machina that do not belong to them. An Auditor's job is to safeguard the survival of Machina as a whole, acting as judge, jury and executioner to do so. In rare cases, where a majority of Machina are in danger, an Auditor may step in, resulting in higher competency from surrounding Machina.
A code within all Machina comprised of an Instinct-Code, Cluster-Code and Identity-Code.

A biometal that makes up the bodies of Machina, extremely dense and embedded with M2 to adapt to any need. Machinium is an extremely strong material, making up the entire body of Machina in various mediums, such a rubbery substance for softer parts such as breasts and faces that can harden in reaction to impacts or flexible hard armour that possesses even stronger resistance.

All Machina possess an Anti-Inertia System within their bodies due to how dense Machinium is, enabling a Machina's weight to become around ten times less than what their mass is. This allows a Machina to not become crushed under their own weight or damage their surroundings.

A term used for when those with low mass are converted into Machina, typically possessing smaller upper bodies and potentially only having wider hips. These Machina are considered to be generally weaker, only reaching around 150cm tall. A Petite Machina can grow into a full bodied Machina with the assistance of a Breeder class Machina
